definitions.explanation: The legal right to possess, use, and dispose of property. A fundamental concept in law covering both physical property and intellectual property.

examples.japanese: {所有権|しょゆうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{移転|いてん}する→移転する：20210_itensuru⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A procedure to transfer ownership is necessary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{所有権|しょゆうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{公示|こうじ}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Real estate ownership is made public through registration.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal term, but also used in everyday contexts when discussing property, cars, and belongings. In Japanese law, {所有権|しょゆうけん} is one of the most fundamental property rights.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {所有権|しょゆうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have ownership)
- {所有権|しょゆうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{移転|いてん}する→移転する：20210_itensuru⟧ (to transfer ownership)
- {所有権|しょゆうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}する→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧ (to claim ownership)
- {所有権|しょゆうけん}⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧ (abandonment of ownership)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{所有|しょゆう}→所有：12752_shoyuu⟧: ownership, possession — the act or state of owning, without the legal-rights nuance
- ⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}→著作権：14022_chosakuken⟧: copyright — specifically for creative works
